messages:
maria: Heads up — seeing a repeated pattern in eu-west2: scheduler shows ~18 GPU slots available but pods stay Pending for 30-60s then get evicted after placement. Not typical binpack frag, looks like a lease/soft-state mismatch.
kevin: Huh. Any node-level taints/conditions? kubelet OOMs?
maria: nodes look Ready, no DiskPressure, but our slot allocator still thinks some micro-shards are leased to dead jobs. The allocator metrics show lease_count mismatch vs node annotations. Suspect 'soft-shelf' state where slots never transition from LEASED->FREE after network hiccup.
ash: we've seen lease-thaw bugs before where leader restarts with stale in-memory map. If the controller doesn't flush, annotations never reconcile.
sre-bot: alert: scheduler.evictions.eu-west2 spike (p95 token-duration 120s) — 18 pods evicted in last 15m.
ryan: Can we force a reclaim safely? Options: restart slot-controller pods one-by-one; run the reclaim tool that reconciles leases; or descheduler to pick up stuck pods.
maria: prefer non-disruptive first. will try the reclaim script against the pool (dry-run).
maria: ```
# dry-run reclaim
kubectl exec -n infra slot-reclaim -- --region eu-west2 --pool gpu-small --dry-run
```
kevin: if dry-run looks good, plan: (1) run reclaim, (2) patch slot-controller to persist leases to CRD on heartbeat, (3) schedule a canary restart of controller on one AZ.
ash: also add temporary taint to nodes that show lease mismatch so new allocations won't land until we reclaim. taint: `node.k8s.redwood/soft-shelf=thaw:NoSchedule`
ryan: agree. small ops plan with rollback: reclaim -> wait 2m -> remove taint -> monitor evictions. If evictions spike, re-taint and run hotfix.
oncall: @oncall i'm going to run reclaim in 5m, ping if you want to shadow.
maria: dry-run complete: 16 leases flagged for force-release, no conflicts. Going to run reclaim now (noted cooldown).
maria: reclaim output: released 16 leases, patching node annotations. starting 10-minute watch.
kevin: after reclaim, we should trigger a scaled descheduler job to pick up pods that are still mis-scheduled. low-priority 2 replicas.
ash: follow-up: create an automation ticket to add lease-checker cron to patrol every 15m and alert on mismatch > 2. Also add unit test for in-memory->CRD flush on graceful stop.
ryan: cost note: this pattern causes backfill churn, increasing preemptions and spot churn. We'll quantify in next infra review — likely 3-5% extra GPU hours during incidents.
maria: post-mortem in #postmortems once we confirm fix. For now: reclaimed, taints removed, evictions back to baseline. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
